about_the_game:
After eons of being imprisoned by the Asgardian gods for his crimes and trickery, Loki has broken free and is taking revenge! Loki has unleashed his army of loyal monsters to terrorize the realms and take control from the Norse gods. Fight back as one of your favorite gods and defeat Loki and his army!

Defeat Loki's Loyal Army

Draugrs, ogres, wolves, and the jotnar - they all fight for Loki and must be stopped! Defeat wave after wave of large hordes of monsters and bosses. Some monsters behave differently and will, for example, shoot projectiles.

Master each god's unique ability

Every god has their own, unique ability you can activate. For example: Thor uses his lightning powers to double all of his stats, while Sif channels the energy of the bifrost to heal herself. Each god's ability creates unique play styles!

Level Up and Gain Powerful Boons

When defeated, enemies will drop XP. Collect enough and you'll level up and get to choose from 3 powerful Boons! Boss enemies will also drop a Bifrost Shard that gives you access to unique Boons. Some Boons boost your stats, some give you new ways of attacking enemies and dealing damage. Collect as many as you can to build the ultimate overpowered god!

Permanently Upgrade Your Character

Gods never die! After dying or completing a run, you'll have the opportunity to spend your hard-earned XP on permanent upgrades. Boost stats for gods or select upgrades unique to each god to make your favorite even stronger!

Explore hand-crafted maps to find hidden upgrades

Each map is hand-designed - no procedural generation here! Hidden within each of them are powerful upgrades. Once you find them, they'll be permanently added to your available pool of upgrades for future runs.

Planned Features

  • 10+ playable Norse gods

  • 30+ Boons

  • Permanent upgrades

  • Multiple maps to explore with secrets and hidden unlockable Boons

  • 30+ Achievements

Level up to gain powerful upgrades and explore hand-crafted maps to find secret items. Build the ultimate overpowered god with permanent upgrades and master each god’s signature weapon.
